variants.asks: every rule of the theory is a term, and every rule touches two things - the population and the space. What ARE the continuous equations, counted off the rules?

steps.because: ANNIHILATION contributes it: its body comes to -2 rays and -1 points of space, its quantifier makes it of degree 2 in the density across an edge, which is the facing factor, and its gates let through what they let through

derivation.because: rule /1 "Annihilation" | σ (x: 1 Edge{active}) => x.ANNIHILATE - -2 rays, -1 points of space. The reading follows the body down through the methods it calls, and the ledgers it moves are counted off the assignments it makes

the rule is quantified over 2 population-bearing refs, so its term carries the density to the power 2 - and the two are across an edge, so the rate goes against the oncoming current, which is the facing factor F
the rule fires only where active, so whatever it does it does on that share of its matches and the term carries it
